        if: steps.check.outputs.should_release == 'true' && steps.check.outputs.skip_bump != 'true'
        run: rust-script rust/scripts/version-and-commit.rs --rust-root rust --tag-prefix rust-v --bump-type "${{ steps.bump.outputs.bump_type
          }}"

name: Wait for macro crate
        if: steps.check.outputs.should_release == 'true' && steps.check.outputs.crate_published != 'true'
        run: rust-script rust/scripts/wait-for-crate.rs --rust-root rust --crate-name lino-i18n-macros --release-version "${{ steps.version.outputs.version
          }}"

name: Wait for runtime crate
        if: steps.check.outputs.should_release == 'true' && steps.check.outputs.crate_published != 'true'
        run: rust-script rust/scripts/wait-for-crate.rs --rust-root rust --crate-name lino-i18n --release-version "${{ steps.version.outputs.version
          }}"

name: Create GitHub release

          "${{ github.repository }}" --tag-prefix rust-v --language Rust

concrete.feature:
release-preflight:
    name: Release credential preflight
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 5
    concurrency:
      group: check-${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}-Release credential preflight
      cancel-in-progress: true
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version: 24.x
      - run: bash scripts/preflight-publish.sh crates
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && (github.event_name == 'push' || (github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.release_mode ==
      'instant'))
    env:
      CARGO_REGISTRY_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.CARGO_REGISTRY_TOKEN || secrets.CARGO_TOKEN }}
